title: To designate the J. Marvin Jones Federal Building and Courthouse in Amarillo, Texas, as the "J. Marvin Jones Federal Building and Mary Lou Robinson United States Courthouse".
official_summary: (Sec. 1) This bill designates the J. Marvin Jones Federal Building and Courthouse at 205 SE 5th Ave., Amarillo, Texas, as the "J. Marvin Jones Federal Building and Mary Lou Robinson United States Courthouse."

summary.headline: A 2018 law renames a federal building and courthouse in Amarillo, Texas, to add the name of judge Mary Lou Robinson.
summary.what_it_does: The law changes the official name of the J. Marvin Jones Federal Building and Courthouse at 205 SE 5th Ave. in Amarillo, Texas. The new name is the J. Marvin Jones Federal Building and Mary Lou Robinson United States Courthouse. It does not change the building's use, rules, or services.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on September 18, 2018.
